params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-secret-input-agent'
if(Test-Path $root){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $root}
git clone https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $root
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
Set-Location $root
git checkout -b agent/bridge-secret-input-20260929 origin/main
$oc='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-tools\opencode\package\bin\opencode.exe'
$cfg='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\opencode-fallback.json'
$env:OPENCODE_CONFIG=$cfg
$prompt=@'
You are the implementation agent for a credential-safe Heaven Local Bridge input lane. Work ONLY in this isolated branch. Inspect repository rules first. Implement a conservative production v1; do not merge main and do not touch relay queue/results history.

Requirements:
1) Add a structured bridge action named secret_input. Queue params MUST contain only an opaque lease handle and UI target metadata; there must be no generic secret_fetch action.
2) Fetch the secret DIRECTLY from heaven2, never through GitHub. Use ssh.exe as an authenticated encrypted stdio transport with argument-array execution, BatchMode=yes, StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, a bounded timeout, validated base64url-style handle, and locally configured authority host/remote script path. Do not pass secret in argv or environment. Never include SSH stdout/stderr containing secret material in BridgeError details, logs, audit rows, results, or checkpoints.
3) Companion authority belongs under plugins/heaven-control-plane/secret-authority/ (new platform code). It must run on Windows heaven2. Create one-time TTL leases from stdin or a secure prompt (never argv), persist only DPAPI-protected bytes under the current user's local application data, validate handles/paths, consume atomically/one-time, and emit the secret only on stdout for the authenticated SSH caller. Keep metadata separate and non-secret.
4) On heaven, secret_input should fetch into memory, optionally focus a semantic UIA selector/window, inject via existing Unicode SendInput typing (not clipboard and not uia_set_value relay text), and return ONLY non-secret metadata such as success, character/UTF-16 counts, transport and target descriptor. Do not return the handle if unnecessary.
5) Fail closed if the authority is unconfigured, SSH host-key verification fails, output is malformed/oversized, lease is expired/consumed, UI target is ambiguous/truncated, or injection fails. Do not echo remote stderr if it may contain sensitive content; use sanitized error codes.
6) Health must accurately advertise secret_input availability/configuration and relay_secret_values_allowed=false.
7) Add strong unit/adversarial tests for relay/result/log non-leakage, replay/one-time behavior (authority tests where practical), malicious handle rejection, timeout, oversized/malformed secret payload, remote failure redaction, password-target injection routing, and feature negotiation.
8) Update bridge/control-plane docs and plugin source metadata. Do not claim the live channel is configured until it actually is. Pick the next appropriate plugin version.
9) Run python compile, bridge primary + compatibility tests, PowerShell parse checks, git diff --check. Commit changes on agent/bridge-secret-input-20260929 and push that branch. Do NOT open/merge a PR if tests fail.
Keep implementation small. Never create sample/test fixtures containing real-looking credentials or secrets.
'@
& $oc run --standalone --auto --model 'ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b' --format json $prompt 2>&1
$agentExit=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ('OPENCODE_EXIT='+$agentExit)
git status --short
if($agentExit -ne 0){exit $agentExit}
python -m py_compile heaven-bridge/worker.py heaven-bridge/test_worker.py heaven-bridge/tests/test_worker.py
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
python heaven-bridge/test_worker.py
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
python heaven-bridge/tests/test_worker.py
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
git diff --check
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
if(-not (git status --porcelain)){Write-Error 'Agent produced no changes'; exit 2}
git add -A
git commit -m 'bridge: add credential-safe direct secret input'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
git push -u origin agent/bridge-secret-input-20260929
exit $LASTEXITCODE
